title: Approve an exact initial parity reference
observed: The product owner approved exact source 4ccb19703d4af1a1c202d922b514a58a17d0e537 as the initial reference while keeping documented defects and edge cases open.
conflict: The original absence of human baseline approval is resolved by PD-001; source acceptance does not approve every observed rule outcome.
decision_required: None for this initial reference. A later baseline move or another specific correction needs separate authority; PD-002 separately resolves RD-007 only.

title: Resolve detailed semantics of the accepted eight-crew direction
observed: The source implements eight distinct crew bonuses. PD-001 accepts retaining that high-level MVP direction instead of the shared bonus, while documented defects and edge cases remain open.
conflict: The high-level plan amendment does not decide every ability's timing, mandatory-choice order, overflow, consent or save compatibility; merged code and passing observations do not supply those rulings.
decision_required: Approve detailed intended ability semantics and their unresolved timing, consent, overflow and save rules before affected implementation. FR-001 priority remains unset pending a separate authorized priority decision.

title: Ordinary draw at the seven-card boundary
observed: The direct rules call draws an eighth card and remains in play; the browser draw gate rejects the same full-hand input.
conflict: Displayed hand rules say activate or cash before drawing into a full hand; the API and UI disagree.
decision_required: Approve the intended hand boundary and an explicit correction or parity exception for the exported draw path.

title: Fixer destination capacity and aggregate overflow
observed: Direct Fixer use appends into a full hand. Two individually permitted Club Circuit targets also leave eight when the first fills the last active slot.
conflict: Displayed rules cap the hand at seven and discard forced-return overflow; acquisition overflow and multi-target preflight are unresolved in FR-001.
decision_required: Choose rejection, discard, or an explicit mandatory destination choice for unplaceable acquisitions; define atomic multi-target handling.

title: Sequence Burbs cash and resource trimming
observed: A fourth legit drawn at a full bank cannot be cashed. Excess human income replaces legit_cash with trim; rival income replaces it with play. Pending data remains.
conflict: The immediate three-legit possession rule conflicts with the resource cap and the observed phase order.
decision_required: Specify the ordering and continuation of mandatory cash/trim decisions for both players, including the at-cap case.

title: Pipeline consent and validation order
observed: An eligible defender automatically spends and takes the operator, even when the attacker cannot pay the intended target cost.
conflict: FR-001 says the owner may intercept; no choice is offered by useOperator and attacker funding is checked after interception.
decision_required: Specify optional human/AI interception, its pending phase, and whether an unfunded attack may trigger it.

title: Legacy helper permissiveness versus the future public command boundary
observed: Invalid opening IDs take the fallback deal, and direct startTurn calls collect income repeatedly in play. Exported runAI returns the human to play with income; browser beginAI returns ready without human income on the same input.
conflict: Resolved by PD-002: public commands reject invalid opening choices and repeated income collection without changing state; end_turn collects next-player income automatically. Precisely linked internal helper observations are excluded only from public-command parity and remain historical evidence.
decision_required: None for this bounded public-command rule. Other unresolved rule decisions, ordinary dependencies, S02 enforcement proof and human acceptance/integration obligations remain operative.

title: Save schema and resume eligibility
observed: The factory and menu predicate use version 7, but the loader accepts only 6. A valid version-6 draw_discard state is rejected by the phase whitelist.
conflict: The README promises unfinished-game resume. Menu eligibility and loaded state disagree; accepted MVP persistence must reject safely without overwriting rejected data.
decision_required: Decide the legacy compatibility policy and approve aligned version, phase, pending-choice, menu and replacement behavior.

title: Ruffian redundant same-crew second target
observed: Club Circuit pays both selected costs upfront; the first Ruffian effect removes that whole crew and the second iteration skips its now-absent target.
conflict: The second paid target adds no effect; FR-001 has not specified whether this is a legal intentional overpayment.
decision_required: Choose whether redundant same-crew targets are forbidden, charged once, or explicitly allowed.

title: Visible return log after overflow discard
observed: Trailer Park overflow correctly records a discard, then also logs that the same distributor returns to hand; the recorded actual destination is Discarded.
conflict: The visible log describes mutually inconsistent destinations.
decision_required: Approve outcome copy derived from the actual destination while retaining or correcting the underlying overflow rule separately.

title: Docks mandatory-choice dismissal and UI gating
observed: The panel renders two discard buttons and Close. Closing removes both choices. drawReason then returns an empty gate reason while drawCard rejects the pending phase.
conflict: A required decision can disappear while ordinary controls appear usable. No absence of an initial discard renderer is claimed.
decision_required: Approve a non-dismissible or reliably reopenable mandatory decision and consistent gating for the remaining controls.

title: AI funding under Hill Country
observed: The rival stops with two surplus resources despite a legal two-for-one trade that immediately funds the held distributor; funding still budgets four.
conflict: FR-001 asks the policy to value/use all new bonuses, while the current prototype heuristic omits this available plan.
decision_required: Choose strict observed policy parity or approve the crew-aware funding correction alongside FR-001.
